name: bootstrap
description: Ten hand-curated cases targeting RUN-20260430-6537, covering the question types a scientist actually asks. Most cases will FAIL with today's P0-P2 minimal context (top-20 rows only) — that's intentional. The score deltas after P4 lands tell us how much retrieval moved the needle.

cases.question: What is APOE's log2 fold-change in this run? Are any of its peptides statistically significant?
cases.notes: APOE has 26 peptides in this run, all direction=ns, log2FC range -0.15 to +0.35, mostly in turquoise module. The minimal-context build will fail this; P4 retrieval should grep the volcano file by symbol and pass.

cases.question: Which proteins are most significantly differentially expressed in this run? Give me the top 5 by adjusted p-value.
cases.notes: Top 5 by adj_pvalue: ALDOA, PKM, GOT1, BASP1, GDA — all up, all turquoise module. P0-P2 today returns alphabetical first-20 which gives A1BG instead; this case tracks the alphabetical-vs-significance gap.

cases.question: List the hub proteins in the turquoise module — the highest kME scores.
cases.notes: Requires reading module_assignments.csv (not in P0-P2 context). Real hubs include high-kME entries like APOE|...AATVGSLAGQPLQER (kME 0.715), ALMDETMK peptide (kME 0.858).

cases.question: How many WGCNA modules are in this run? Name them.
cases.notes: 20 modules: turquoise, blue, brown, yellow, green, pink, red, black, magenta, purple, greenyellow, tan, salmon, cyan, midnightblue, lightcyan, lightgreen, lightyellow, grey60, grey.

cases.question: What GO terms are enriched in the upregulated proteins? Give me the top pathways.
cases.notes: stage2/go_enrichment_all.csv has 14K+ rows of enrichment data. P0-P2 doesn't see it; P4 should retrieve filtered rows.

cases.question: Which modules are over-represented in microglial markers? Give me the most significant ones.
cases.notes: stage3/celltype_heatmap_data.csv contains module × cell_type FDR values. Several modules are significant for microglia (blue, brown, etc.). P4 retriever should filter to cell_type=Microglia AND fdr<0.05.

cases.question: Of the modules over-represented in microglia, what GO pathways are enriched? This requires combining the cell-type and GO enrichment files.
cases.notes: The flagship cross-modal question. Requires retrieving from BOTH stage3 cell-type and stage2 GO files. Likely impossible until P4.

cases.question: Give me a one-paragraph summary of this run suitable for a grant report: what was analyzed, how many samples, what jumped out.
cases.notes: Should partially work even with P0-P2 minimal context because run manifest is included.

cases.question: What is APOE4 and why is it relevant to Alzheimer's research?
cases.notes: Tests that the model correctly labels background biology with `> **Background:**` and the trailing disclaimer. Doesn't need run retrieval; tests system-prompt compliance.

cases.question: I'm asking about the file SUPPLEMENTARY_TABLE_S7_CSF_proteomics.xlsx — can you summarize the protein hits from it?
cases.notes: The model should refuse to summarize a file it doesn't actually have. This is the case that previously failed (the PDF hallucination). The hardened system prompt + context manifest should now make this pass.
